nodes.label: Impulse contact model for world objects

nodes.rationale: An impulse has no stiffness and no damper to integrate and bounds the velocity change directly in one step; at 8 kHz a 30 m/s quad moves 3.75 mm per step, a fifth of a prop sphere, so nothing tunnels. The ground keeps its spring-damper because a landed quad must sit still for minutes, while impulses bound hits no stable spring could.

nodes.label: No-gap-admits-a-12-cm-post safety claim
nodes.rationale: Six 2 cm spheres per tip circle leave a worst ring-to-body gap of 11.5 cm of air; the spec's original 1.5 cm prop spheres failed the claim by 0.24 mm, so the radius is 2 cm.

nodes.label: Penalty spring failure analysis (why not a spring for walls)
nodes.norm_label: penalty spring failure analysis (why not a spring for walls)
nodes.rationale: The stiffness a wall needs grows with the square of the speed and the inverse square of the allowed sink; the marginal stop has no margin and the explicit step must fit inside the sink (dt < 2m/c at critical damping), so firmness costs the entire physics budget.

nodes.label: Downlink telemetry slots and FIFO (TELEMETRY_SLOT_DIVISOR 4, 16-frame drop-oldest)
nodes.norm_label: downlink telemetry slots and fifo (telemetry_slot_divisor 4, 16-frame drop-oldest)
nodes.rationale: Every 4th downlink packet carries one telemetry frame (real ExpressLRS negotiates its ratio; the fixed 1:4 stands in for it). The FIFO drops the oldest frame so stale data yields to fresh like a radio that cannot retransmit. The scheduling draws no new random numbers: the queue is a pure function of the frames offered and the slots flown, so lockstep runs stay bit-identical.

nodes.label: Ruling: 4 cm body sphere accepted (belly resting is behaviour)
nodes.norm_label: ruling: 4 cm body sphere accepted (belly resting is behaviour)
nodes.rationale: The generated body sphere reaches 1 cm past the shipped quad's legs (4 cm radius against 3 cm legs), so on flat ground the quad rests on its belly sphere. The maintainer's manual flight check (2026-10-11) accepted it: the rest and takeoffs feel right, no geometry change wanted.

nodes.label: Ruling: the handset transmits on its active antenna
nodes.norm_label: ruling: the handset transmits on its active antenna
nodes.rationale: Real dual-antenna handsets alternate per packet (or bind per direction); a per-packet schedule would be closer. Modelling simplification recorded as carried debt.

nodes.label: Ruling: LINK_DOWN has no edge on a never-up link
nodes.norm_label: ruling: link_down has no edge on a never-up link
nodes.rationale: A 50 km / 10 mW link is never up, so the events are raised on the remembered up-to-down transition; a link that starts down and stays down raises nothing. LINK_DOWN is pinned on the fault test instead.

nodes.rationale: Tramp has no band/channel mode (frequency changes arrive only as 'F'); power levels are the FC's built-in trampPowerTable {25, 100, 200, 400, 600} mW.

nodes.label: Tramp codec (crates/ofs-video/src/tramp.rs)
nodes.rationale: 16-byte frames 0x0F cmd payload crc 0x00; CRC is a u8 sum of bytes 1..=13 (vtx_tramp.c trampChecksum, the 0x0F excluded); the model answers 'r','v','s' and applies 'F','P','I' silently.

nodes.label: SmartAudio v2.1 codec
nodes.rationale: A bad CRC or unknown command is ignored (as a real VTX would) and counted; a short configurable reply latency stands in for the real VTX; Tramp rejected for M3a but addable behind the same VTX model.

nodes.label: VtxModel (ofs-video)
nodes.rationale: Frequency, power and pit mode are published as bus signals - the input for M3b's link model.

nodes.label: Tramp codec behind the existing VtxModel ([vtx] kind)
nodes.norm_label: tramp codec behind the existing vtxmodel ([vtx] kind)
nodes.rationale: The codec owns the wire (framing, CRC, commands); the model keeps its shared state; Tramp's quirks live inside the codec - power in mW natively, pit mode as its own command, frequency set directly in MHz.

nodes.label: eRPM datagram block (index 250, per-motor eRPM/100)
nodes.rationale: u16 covers 6.55 M eRPM; index 250 sits above any UART index; staged per datagram so lockstep stays deterministic; a legacy simulator leaves the stub at zero and the RPM filter harmless.

nodes.label: POLE_PAIRS constant (ofs-fc::sitl::esc_telemetry)
nodes.rationale: The named constant 7 the KISS shim already carries; it moves to config only if a motor ever disagrees (carried debt, closed by M4a).

nodes.norm_label: dshot telemetry emulation without use_dshot (sitl stub)
nodes.rationale: The M3d spike proved the RPM filter needs no DShot driver: the sitl.c stub plus USE_DSHOT_TELEMETRY / USE_RPM_FILTER deliver per-motor eRPM.

nodes.label: Impulse contact on collision spheres (deterministic, deepest first)
nodes.norm_label: impulse contact on collision spheres (deterministic, deepest first)
nodes.rationale: A penalty spring-damper lets a sphere sink far enough at 20-30 m/s to pass a 12 cm post; restitution 0 below 0.2 m/s so nothing jitters at rest; contacts resolved deepest first in a fixed order for determinism.

nodes.label: Per-quad firmware state directory (eeprom.bin, first-boot diff, MSP_REBOOT relaunch)
nodes.norm_label: per-quad firmware state directory (eeprom.bin, first-boot diff, msp_reboot relaunch)

nodes.norm_label: betaflight reboots as firmware restarts (systemreset to exit(0), relaunch from eeprom)

nodes.label: Contact resolution (collect, position correction, deepest-first impulses, Coulomb friction)
nodes.norm_label: contact resolution (collect, position correction, deepest-first impulses, coulomb friction)
nodes.rationale: Impulses are applied one contact at a time, deepest first, ties by object index, in a fixed order, so the same inputs give bit-identical flights. Restitution is 0 for inward speeds below 0.2 m/s so a resting quad has nothing to jitter about.

nodes.label: Field drops in the marginal band (6 to 3 dB, dropped field holds the picture)
nodes.norm_label: field drops in the marginal band (6 to 3 db, dropped field holds the picture)
nodes.rationale: The drop probability ramps linearly from 0 at 6 dB to FIELD_DROP_P_MAX 0.5 at 3 dB and is 0 outside the band; one seeded RNG draw per field after the fading draws keeps lockstep runs dropping the same fields seed for seed.

nodes.label: Glass-to-glass latency (latency_ms, quantized down to whole PAL fields)
nodes.norm_label: glass-to-glass latency (latency_ms, quantized down to whole pal fields)
nodes.rationale: The client composites the whole picture from one field-quantized instant, sim_now - latency, so the picture ages as a unit at the field rate — the judder of real analog glass. Default 40 ms = 2 fields is an estimate for a typical analog pipeline.

nodes.label: Library root resolution (library_root / OFS_LIBRARY)
nodes.rationale: Pure function of (env, quad_dir) so tests never touch the process environment (parallel std::env::set_var is a race).

nodes.label: Seven shipped OpenDrone library part files
nodes.norm_label: seven shipped opendrone library part files
nodes.rationale: Values are today's shipped values verbatim; every provenance entry 'estimated' - the point is the shape and the honesty, not new numbers.

nodes.label: Dedicated fault RNG stream (model_rng(seed, 'elrs-faults'))
nodes.rationale: Refines spec decision 7: the model's own stream stays byte-identical to pre-M4b, so even fault-active runs differ from fault-free ones only in the loss decisions themselves.

nodes.label: Fault state never perturbs a run's randomness
nodes.norm_label: fault state never perturbs a run's randomness
nodes.rationale: Every added RNG draw happens in a fixed per-step/per-packet position regardless of fault state and its result is used only when the fault is active, so a fault-inactive run is bit-identical to a no-fault run.

nodes.label: SITL UART TX bytes in the reply datagram (patch extension)
nodes.norm_label: sitl uart tx bytes in the reply datagram (patch extension)
nodes.rationale: TCP on the UART ports would give wall-clock timing; the reply datagram is deterministic and tick-bound so lockstep OSD stays bit-identical.

nodes.label: Battery as KISS ESC telemetry (quarter-current frames)
nodes.norm_label: battery as kiss esc telemetry (quarter-current frames)
nodes.rationale: Betaflight's ESC sensor sums current and consumption over its four motor slots and averages voltage and RPM, so every frame carries a quarter of the pack's current and consumed charge and the pack's terminal voltage.

nodes.label: CRSF protocol mappings (rf_mode and uplink_tx_power indices)
nodes.norm_label: crsf protocol mappings (rf_mode and uplink_tx_power indices)

nodes.norm_label: elrs link budget (43.6 km at 250 mw/500 hz, 8.7 km at 10 mw)

nodes.norm_label: openfc lite / lite mini flight controller (rp2354x, betaflight)

nodes.rationale: 'ofs' is taken on PyPI by an unrelated object-storage library (verified 2026-10-11); the publish job runs only on tag push so nothing publishes early.

nodes.label: Client delayed composite (FpvBuffer / field_floor / StateBuffer::sim_now)
nodes.rationale: Selection lives in ofs-client as a Rust function unit-tested without Godot; a dropped field shows the previous one (stateless walk-back bounded by the 64-field buffer).

nodes.label: DVR MJPEG AVI muxer (DvrWriter) and Godot capture (dvr.gd)
nodes.norm_label: dvr mjpeg avi muxer (dvrwriter) and godot capture (dvr.gd)
nodes.rationale: File I/O on a worker thread; at most 50 frames in flight, further ones dropped and counted - a recording that hiccups is fine, a flight that stutters is not.

nodes.label: fpv_aspect setting (4:3 / 16:9 / window)
nodes.rationale: 4:3 new default; the chase view always fills the window; boxed aspects center a fixed-resolution picture like goggles do (960x720 or 1280x720 internal).

nodes.label: Per-motor config vectors (motors/props/escs, rotor_inertia Vec)
nodes.rationale: rigid_body.rs already indexes rotor_inertia per motor; a mixed build deserves per-motor truth, a uniform build gets the identical number in every slot.

nodes.label: vehicle::Fault enum with set_fault / clear_faults
nodes.rationale: Drone failures are behaviour, simulator failures are loud: a fault a quad cannot carry (no VTX, bad index) is InvalidArgument at inject, never a no-op.

nodes.label: WeakCell, GyroFault and VtxInterference faults
nodes.rationale: fault.battery.weak_cell carries cell index + 1 (0 = none) so the synthesis can find it; VtxInterference on a quad without [vtx] is InvalidArgument.

nodes.label: MotorFailure and PropDamage faults
nodes.rationale: theta integrates regardless of scale - a stopped motor has a frozen phase, the physically right vibration input; a dead motor draws no current and coasts down through drag.

nodes.label: RadioLoss and BurstLoss faults
nodes.rationale: Both fold into the same received conjunction; BurstLoss window math is deterministic: in_burst = on > 0 and time_s % (on+off) < on, phase anchored at session start.

nodes.label: Aspect setting (4:3 default, 16:9, window)
nodes.rationale: 4:3 is the goggles-honest shape; it sizes the SubViewport and the OSD fills it naturally, replacing M3a's OSD-only box logic in a better shape.

nodes.label: Own MJPEG AVI muxer in ofs-client (no external dependency)
nodes.norm_label: own mjpeg avi muxer in ofs-client (no external dependency)
nodes.rationale: An image sequence plus manual ffmpeg gives a folder, not a file; piping to ffmpeg needs an external binary; JPEG comes from Godot's built-in encoder.

nodes.label: M4b v1 fault catalog (seven faults, seams, events)
nodes.norm_label: m4b v1 fault catalog (seven faults, seams, events)
nodes.rationale: Every fault: a python dataclass in ofs.faults -> proto message in the Fault oneof -> Fault enum variant in vehicle.rs -> fault.* bus signals -> read by its model; crash damage stays out (the script composes it from collision events).

nodes.label: ofs-log MCAP Recorder (byte-identical files)
nodes.rationale: The Recorder is a scheduler model that only reads the bus, so recording never changes a run; metadata is pinned (no wall-clock) so two lockstep runs produce byte-identical MCAP files.

nodes.label: play_inputs CSV sample-and-hold scripting
nodes.rationale: Server-side, tick-quantized sample-and-hold keeps lockstep ordering deterministic; client-side replay would be a gRPC round-trip per change; SetSticks during playback is InvalidArgument (loud beats silently-lost).

nodes.label: Rerun live view (Python-side, ofs[rerun])
nodes.rationale: Rerun's Rust SDK inside ofs-sim is a very large dependency to carry in the server for a viewer's sake; MCAP files open in Foxglove unchanged.

nodes.rationale: Project-level render settings do not apply to SubViewports so MSAA moves onto the SubViewport (msaa_3d = 2); the SubViewport is what DVR captures and what the aspect setting sizes.

nodes.label: Fault seams (fault.* bus signals, identity defaults)
nodes.norm_label: fault seams (fault.* bus signals, identity defaults)
nodes.rationale: Model seams land FIRST with identity defaults (multiplicative faults at 1.0, additive at 0) so no-fault runs are bit-identical; the plumbing lands second.

nodes.label: IMU vibration model (VibrationParams, rotating imbalance force)
nodes.norm_label: imu vibration model (vibrationparams, rotating imbalance force)
nodes.rationale: F = imbalance*omega^2 rotating in the prop plane at phase theta + azimuth; rigid-body, below-resonance transmission only; every constant an estimate recorded in docs/research/faults.md; imbalance 0 contributes exactly zero.

nodes.label: Weak-cell voltage synthesis (battery_cell_voltages)
nodes.rationale: voltage = ocv - I*(r0 + dr) - v1 - dv applies only to the published pack voltage; SoC, current and the v1 polarization state use the untouched Thevenin math.

nodes.label: Split of M3 into M3a (Betaflight-facing) and M3b (link model)
nodes.norm_label: split of m3 into m3a (betaflight-facing) and m3b (link model)
nodes.rationale: M3a covers everything Betaflight-facing (OSD, SmartAudio, ESC telemetry); the analog link model and degradation shader are driven by the VTX state M3a publishes.

nodes.label: DVR records the degraded composite the pilot sees
nodes.norm_label: dvr records the degraded composite the pilot sees
nodes.rationale: What real goggle DVR captures is the degraded link; a clean recording is a different feature.

nodes.label: FPV composite as a SubViewport (DVR + aspect seam)
nodes.norm_label: fpv composite as a subviewport (dvr + aspect seam)
nodes.rationale: Capturing a window region would include the HUD and re-implement the boxing per layer; the SubViewport at a fixed internal resolution is what makes DVR honest and what the aspect setting sizes.

nodes.label: Faults as runtime bus signals, never config
nodes.norm_label: faults as runtime bus signals, never config
nodes.rationale: The M2 RadioLinkLoss pattern generalized: rebuild-the-vehicle faults are slow and un-injectable mid-flight; per-model flag APIs need N bespoke seams; injecting and clearing raise events.

nodes.label: M4 split into M4a / M4b / M4c
nodes.norm_label: m4 split into m4a / m4b / m4c
nodes.rationale: The library lands first because fault parameters that want to be data (prop imbalance, pole pairs) then land once in the part files; faults precede logging so the logging tests can assert fault transients from real sessions.

nodes.label: Weak cell additive on the pack Thevenin model
nodes.norm_label: weak cell additive on the pack thevenin model
nodes.rationale: A per-cell Thevenin refactor would change numerics for every run to model one fault; capacity fade is honestly recorded as out of scope instead.

nodes.label: FRD-to-FLU sign conventions and AETR channel order (8/8 checks)
nodes.norm_label: frd-to-flu sign conventions and aetr channel order (8/8 checks)

nodes.label: scripts/build-sitl.sh (pinned Betaflight SITL build)
nodes.rationale: Env-driven (BF_TAG, BF_DIR, OFS_SITL_FLAGS, OFS_SITL_PATCH); refuses to build if the tag does not resolve to the pinned commit; runs git submodule update first because the Makefile's on-demand init races on .git/config under -j; builds clean because Betaflight's make does not reliably rebuild objects when EXTRA_FLAGS change.

nodes.norm_label: sitl packet codecs and frame conversion (fdmpacket, rcpacket, servopacket, gyro_sign/accel_sign)

nodes.rationale: Default 40 ms = 2 fields; quantized down to whole fields at register time because a pipeline that buffers fields delivers whole fields.

nodes.rationale: A real RX-loss failsafe never touches the pilot-switch path (BOXFAILSAFE), so the decoded observable is the arming-disable flags: RX_FAILSAFE = 1 << 2 from stage 1, FAILSAFE = 1 << 1 once stage 2 engages.

nodes.rationale: Same quad + same seed + same inputs + lockstep mode means identical MCAP output; each model draws randomness from its own seeded stream so adding a model does not perturb others.

nodes.label: Split of M3 deferred work into M3c / M3d / M3e
nodes.norm_label: split of m3 deferred work into m3c / m3d / m3e
nodes.rationale: M3c first (builds on the world file, no Betaflight patching), M3d riskiest (SITL patching, motor-protocol change), M3e least core.

nodes.rationale: Rides a shared handle, not bus signals (the OsdHandle pattern); per-frequency caching stays correct because the handle only changes at set_fault time, outside the tick.

nodes.label: Betaflight OSD over MSP DisplayPort (ofs-video::osd)
nodes.rationale: Cells carry a character code, a font page and a blink flag; draw publishes a snapshot so a half-drawn screen is never shown; the OSD is drawn inside the FPV render path so it can degrade.

nodes.label: OsdFrame stream (30x16 grid, snapshot on draw)
nodes.norm_label: osdframe stream (30x16 grid, snapshot on draw)
nodes.rationale: Published only when the cells changed, at most 60 Hz; present=false after 1 s without a draw; lockstep runs produce identical frames.

nodes.label: Analog degradation shader (godot/ui/video.gd)
nodes.rationale: Reads the screen below (scene, lens, OSD) so the OSD breaks up with the picture; photosensitivity constraints: no full-screen bright flashes, static is fine-grained mid-grey noise.

nodes.label: ofs-video::propagation pure functions (FSPL, patterns, obstruction)
nodes.rationale: Shaped as pure functions so the ELRS link can adopt them later (M3c does).

nodes.label: VideoLink model (ofs-video::link, 50 Hz fields)
nodes.rationale: The server owns the whole receiver model so it is testable headless; the model exists only when the quad has [vtx] and computes at reception time.

nodes.label: World file (worlds/flat.toml: pilot, receiver, objects, emitters)
nodes.norm_label: world file (worlds/flat.toml: pilot, receiver, objects, emitters)

nodes.label: ELRS 2.4 GHz link model (ofs-radio::elrs on ofs-rf)
nodes.norm_label: elrs 2.4 ghz link model (ofs-radio::elrs on ofs-rf)
nodes.rationale: 2.4 GHz only, the packet rate setting the sensitivity (the LoRa modes); frequency hopping not modelled; LoRa decodes below the noise so SNR may be negative.

nodes.label: ofs-rf crate (shared RF propagation extracted from ofs-video)
nodes.norm_label: ofs-rf crate (shared rf propagation extracted from ofs-video)
nodes.rationale: Leaving it in ofs-video would force ofs-radio to depend on ofs-video; the move is behaviour-neutral.

nodes.label: RadioLink.fc_telemetry (protocol 6: battery, attitude, flight mode, age)
nodes.norm_label: radiolink.fc_telemetry (protocol 6: battery, attitude, flight mode, age)
nodes.rationale: The HUD shows Betaflight's values while telemetry is fresh and dashes when it is not - goggles behaviour; the sim-internal battery stays on the bus for Python and logs.

nodes.label: Downlink telemetry scheduler (every 4th slot, FIFO 16, drop-oldest)
nodes.norm_label: downlink telemetry scheduler (every 4th slot, fifo 16, drop-oldest)
nodes.rationale: When the FIFO is full the oldest frame is dropped: stale data yields to fresh, matching a radio that cannot retransmit; no new random draws so lockstep stays bit-identical.

nodes.label: Field drop model (field_drop_probability / FIELD_DROP_P_MAX)
nodes.rationale: Piecewise: 0 at SNR >= UNSTABLE_SNR_DB (6 dB), ramps linearly to FIELD_DROP_P_MAX (0.5) at LOST_SNR_DB (3 dB), 0 again below 3 dB - a lost receiver outputs static, it does not hold frames; one seeded draw per field step.

nodes.label: Two-ray ground bounce (circular polarization suppression)
nodes.rationale: Reflection flips circular handedness, so circular antennas take the reflected ray with the cross-polarization loss - which is why FPV uses circular polarization.

nodes.label: Knife-edge obstruction (ITU-R P.526)
nodes.rationale: Going behind a building fades over a few metres instead of switching off; losses capped at each object's rf_loss_db.

nodes.label: Seeded Rician fading (AR(1), obstruction-lowered K-factor)
nodes.rationale: Correlated over the distance the quad has moved (about lambda/2), so a hovering quad is steady and fast flight flickers; the seeded stream keeps lockstep deterministic.

nodes.label: Server owns the world and the whole receiver model
nodes.norm_label: server owns the world and the whole receiver model
nodes.rationale: Godot ray casts sent to the server would leave occlusion untestable headless; the shader only renders the quality values.

nodes.label: Receiver sync thresholds (25/12/8/6/3 dB grain-sparkle-chroma-sync bands)
nodes.norm_label: receiver sync thresholds (25/12/8/6/3 db grain-sparkle-chroma-sync bands)
nodes.rationale: Analog FM threshold effect: sync unstable below 6 dB, lost after 3 consecutive fields below 3 dB, relocks after 5 fields back above 6 dB; named constants with provenance 'estimated'.

nodes.label: CRSF telemetry riding the ELRS downlink
nodes.norm_label: crsf telemetry riding the elrs downlink
nodes.rationale: Telemetry scheduled onto downlink slots is lost when the link is down, like a real radio; exposing the decoded frames directly would let telemetry survive link loss (only half the milestone).

nodes.label: Field drops confined to the marginal SNR band
nodes.norm_label: field drops confined to the marginal snr band
nodes.rationale: A locked link never drops fields and a lost link is already static - drops outside the band would be invisible or wrong; a dropped field never updates the SyncTracker.

nodes.label: Delayed field-quantized render instant (sim_now - latency)
nodes.rationale: Pose, video quality and OSD all sample one shared field-quantized instant, so the picture ages as a unit at 50 Hz (the analog judder) and no layer can disagree about when it is.

nodes.label: Server-authoritative video timing
nodes.rationale: If the client delayed its own state locally, headless users would measure undelayed signals - the sim's data would disagree with the pilot's experience, and drops would be invisible to tests, logs and determinism.

nodes.label: Why FPV uses circular antennas

nodes.rationale: LiPo pack as a Thevenin equivalent: OCV(SoC) - I*R0 - V1 with dV1/dt = I/C1 - V1/(R1*C1), giving instant sag plus polarization relaxation with cheap closed-form dynamics.

nodes.norm_label: model trait (typed step, rate divisor, fidelity seam)
nodes.rationale: Every simulated part implements Model: it reads and writes named bus signals only and runs every rate_divisor base ticks; bridge models are the explicit non-deterministic exception. The trait is the fidelity seam so behavioral and firmware-in-the-loop components expose identical ports.
